Events

Simple Gifts for the Holidays Tours

Dec 02, 2026

Prepare for the Christmas season by visiting the Perkins Stone Mansion to see Simple GIfts for the Holidays. Enjoy seeing vintage clothing, toys and products from local stores like Polsky's and O'Neil's including characters from their infamous window displays.

Tours available through Saturday, December 19th. Visit on Wednesdays, Thursdays, Fridays and Saturdays with tours at 1 p.m., 2 p.m. and 3 p.m.

Tickets will be available online and at the Society's Woodshed Emporium in the office building. Keep the Society's gift shop in mind as you plan for your holiday shopping too!
